notes: Excluded under function (Step 1, item 5). The proposed learned method is an adversarial evasion-attack detector: p. 5 'to filter out adversarial data' and p. 6 (Fig. 3), a direct XGBoost detector plus a Random Forest on SHAP attributions in a stacked ensemble. The beamforming predictor is a six-layer fully connected network from [35] used as the protected victim model (p. 8, 'The NN structure comprises six fully connected layers'); it is not a contribution. The paper reports achievable rate with and without the defense (p. 10) but proposes no beamforming method. Attack detection is a security function of the same family as anti-jamming and signal identification, which the protocol excludes. Borderline: the reviewer may weigh the achievable-rate results and the DeepMIMO beam-prediction setting (area 3). Title and DOI on p. 1 match.
